insurerHighlights.title: Providing this information is genuine patient service.
insurerHighlights.intro: This is not about selling insurance in your practice. It is about not leaving patients unaware: subsidy and protection routes may make a treatment decision financially easier, yet many patients would never discover them without a brief referral.

highlights.title: Even when treatment has already been advised or started.
highlights.text: The Bayerische ZAHN Sofort component can pay up to 1,500 EUR without a waiting period, capped at 750 EUR per calendar year. It must be selected before treatment is completed or invoiced.

highlights.title: Dental cleaning without an annual limit
highlights.text: UKV ZahnPRIVAT 90 and 100 reimburse professional dental cleaning without an annual limit.

highlights.title: Up to 100% reimbursement
highlights.text: Depending on the starting position, strong plans may cover up to 100% of eligible costs including statutory health insurance benefits.

highlights.title: Up to 3 missing teeth can be insured
highlights.text: With UKV, up to 3 existing, unreplaced missing teeth can be included for a fixed surcharge. Future dental restoration used to close those gaps can then be covered within the policy terms. The gap closure must not have been advised before purchase; reimbursement schedules and underwriting still apply.

insurerHighlights.teamTitle: One sentence for your team is enough:
insurerHighlights.teamQuote: If you would like help with your patient share, Healio shows you possible subsidy and protection routes. Healio provides the advice.
insurerHighlights.practiceNote: Your practice does not recommend a plan. Healio checks eligibility, explains benefit limits and provides the documented advice.
insurerHighlights.sourceNote: Policy extracts as of August 2026. The current policy terms, reimbursement limits and individual underwriting decision apply.

challenge.title: The best treatment is planned. Then the conversation turns to money.
challenge.text: A convincing treatment and cost plan can falter once the patient share becomes visible. Patients delay decisions, choose a simpler treatment or leave the conversation uncertain.
challenge.closing: Your practice should not have to solve this financial question. It can, however, open a neutral door to independent information.

bonus.title: First check what is already available in the system.
bonus.intro: Many patients know neither the potential of their health fund bonuses nor the differences between supplementary dental plans. Healio brings both into a personal review — transparent, voluntary and appropriate to the current dental status.

steps.title: Clarify bonus potential
steps.text: We check which documented bonus activities and reimbursement routes of the relevant health fund may be available.

steps.title: Select suitable protection
steps.text: Health status, advised treatment, benefit preferences and budget determine which solution is appropriate at all.

steps.title: Put the premium in context
steps.text: We show transparently which portion of a premium an attainable health fund bonus may cover in the individual case.

bonus.disclaimer: There is no blanket promise of free cover. Bonuses, subsidies and insurance benefits always depend on personal circumstances, evidence and the applicable fund and policy terms.

founder.text: I founded Healio to close precisely that gap. We do not merely want to broker insurance. We want to make existing options understandable, provide patients with financial relief and give dentists the space to focus on treatment.

legal.title: Trust grows from clear boundaries.
legal.intro: The partnership is deliberately restrained. Your practice neither provides information on specific plans nor participates in a purchase. Healio handles the full brokerage and advisory process with interested patients.

items.title: Unpaid partnership
items.text: The practice receives no commission, reward or other benefit for contacts or purchases.

items.title: Neutral information material
items.text: The patient information explains cost and protection routes objectively. It recommends no product and does not call for a purchase.

items.title: No advice by the team
items.text: For insurance questions, the practice team refers patients exclusively to Healio. Product selection, documentation and advice take place there.

items.title: Direct patient contact
items.text: The practice collects or transfers no data. Patients scan the QR code themselves and independently choose whether to get in touch.

legal.closingTitle: Your practice remains the medical point of contact. Healio remains the insurance broker.
legal.closingText: For a regional rollout, the actual material is reviewed against the professional rules of the relevant regional dental chamber. This replaces blanket legal promises with a documented review process.
legal.disclaimer: Note: This presentation does not constitute legal advice. The applicable regional professional rules, the actual design and the way the material is used in the practice are decisive.

package.title: Little material. One clear function.
package.intro: Your practice receives exactly what is needed for a restrained patient service — without a training programme or a sales process at reception.

items.title: Neutral patient information
items.text: An objective overview of patient shares, statutory benefits and possible supplementary protection routes.

items.title: One-page team guide
items.text: Clear wording for patient questions and equally clear boundaries around what the practice team does not provide.

items.title: Practice-specific QR code
items.text: Patients go directly to Healio. On request, the practice receives aggregate usage figures only, never names or health data.

package.note: The placement and format of the material are coordinated with the relevant chamber during the pilot. Large promotional displays and active product pitches are not part of the model.

faq.title: Questions from everyday practice
faq.intro: The most important points for practice owners and practice management at a glance.

items.q: What does the partnership cost our practice?
items.a: The introductory meeting and coordinated information material are free for your practice. There is no minimum term and no compensation for recommendations.

items.q: Should our team actively approach patients about insurance?
items.a: No. The model uses objective, passive information. Your team neither recommends a plan nor presses patients to make contact. It refers insurance questions exclusively to Healio.

items.q: Can a health fund bonus cover the full insurance premium?
items.a: This may be possible in individual situations, but it is not a blanket promise. The health fund, completed bonus activities, evidenced costs, policy and premium are decisive. Healio provides an individual and transparent calculation.
Your practice neither collects nor transfers data to Healio. Only when a patient contacts Healio independently does Healio process the information required within its own area of responsibility.

items.q: Can the model be used identically in every chamber district?
items.a: The model professional code is only a starting point; the relevant regional professional rules are binding. Reviewing the actual material with the relevant chamber is therefore part of the regional pilot process.
